in_sanskrit.name: नागेन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who shelters or protects like a serpent, or a descendant of a serpent deity, and is also the lord of Indra, the rain god.

in_hindi.name: नागेन्द्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: Swami of the Nagas or Lord of the Serpents, also associated with Indra, the rain god.

in_tamil.name: நாகேந்திர
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is the lord or representative of the Nagas or serpent deities.

in_telugu.name: నాగేదర
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is the lord or master of the Nagas or serpent deities.

in_marathi.name: Nagendr
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Serpents
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nagendr हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules over serpents and poisons, often considered a form of Lord Shiva.

in_bengali.name: Nagendr
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Serpents
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nagendr একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who rules over serpents and poisons, often considered a form of Lord Shiva.
